# netbox_tokens (Data Source)

Retrieves all tokens from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_tokens" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "created"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "tokens_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_tokens.example.tokens[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) The tokens found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) When the tokens was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the tokens.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the tokens.
- `expires` (String) The expires of the tokens.
- `id` (Number) The id of the tokens.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key of the tokens.
- `last_used` (String) The last used of the tokens.
- `pepper_id` (Number) The pepper id of the tokens.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token of the tokens.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the tokens.
- `version` (Number) The version of the tokens.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) The write enabled of the tokens.
